steps.en: Add the server to your MCP client config
steps.zh: 在 MCP 客户端配置里加上这个服务器

steps.en: Starts or attaches Chrome on the first tool call that needs a browser
steps.zh: 直到第一次调用需要浏览器的工具，才启动或附着 Chrome

steps.en: Ask the agent to inspect a live page
steps.zh: 让 agent 去检查一个真实页面

steps.en: Drives the page over the DevTools Protocol, auto-waiting for action results
steps.zh: 通过 DevTools 协议驱动页面，自动等待动作生效

steps.en: Records a trace and returns actionable performance insights
steps.zh: 录制 trace 并返回可执行的性能洞察

value.en: A coding agent with the full DevTools surface — traces, network, console, heap — on a real Chrome you never opened
value.zh: agent 直接拿到完整 DevTools 能力——trace、网络、控制台、堆——不必亲手打开 Chrome

sources: README.md (Getting started: MCP config JSON; Your first prompt: 'Check the performance of https://developers.chrome.com'; note that the server starts the browser only when a tool requiring it is called)
docs/cli.md (Puppeteer-based automation, auto-wait for action results, per README Key features)
